title: Hall Corner
notes: CROP of a great hall's SW corner: two of its walls in frame (west wall down file d with a door, south wall on rank 5 with double doors), the hall's north and east walls lie off-frame. A passage runs down the west edge past a wall stub, a corridor crosses under the hall, and two lesser rooms sit below it — one through a door, one through a broken gap and a corridor mouth at the east edge.
